deny.name: no-json-new
deny.message: Opening a tab with /json/new brings the automation Chrome to the front. Open it in the background: {skill_dir}/bin/chrome-real.sh start "<url>" or node {skill_dir}/bin/cdp.mjs "<url>".

deny.name: automation-chrome-stays-behind
deny.message: Do not bring the automation Chrome to the front by hand. To sign in once: {skill_dir}/bin/chrome-real.sh login "<url>"; to work: chrome-real.sh start "<url>" (stays behind).
